title: The Journey Begins: Crafting a New Space for Machine Knitters
author: Sue Jalowiec
excerpt: A fresh, modern start for machine knitters. Knit by Machine is taking shape one tool, one answer, and one small step at a time — and you’re invited to be part of the journey.
body:
The Journey Begins: Crafting a New Space for Machine Knitters

A fresh, modern home for machine knitters who want clarity, confidence, and practical guidance — without the clutter or overwhelm.

Knit by Machine is built for knitters who want answers quickly, who appreciate clean design, and who enjoy tools that make knitting easier and more fun. Everything here is shaped around what helps you succeed at your machine.

What You’ll Find Here

Knit by Machine is centered around three simple, powerful pillars:

Ask ’n Answer (ANA)

Fast, straightforward answers to the questions that hold you back at the machine. No searching through forums or guessing — just clear explanations that help you move forward.

Skill & Technique Guides

Encouraging, step-by-step walkthroughs for essential skills, troubleshooting, shaping, finishing, and more. Each guide is designed to build confidence as you go.

Interactive Wizards

Smart calculators, pattern planners, and practice tools that take care of the math and remove the mystery. You can focus on knitting instead of crunching numbers.

What’s Coming

I’m adding new tools, guides, and ANA entries every week. Your feedback shapes what appears next, so if something would make your knitting easier, please tell me — I’m listening.

Ready to Explore?

Start with the Ask ’n Answer catalog or jump into the Interactive Wizards to see what’s possible.

Happy knitting!
— Sue

Questions & Answers

What is Knit by Machine?

Knit by Machine is a fresh, modern home for machine knitters. It offers clarity, confidence, and practical guidance without clutter or overwhelm — so you can get answers quickly and enjoy using your knitting machine.

Who is Knit by Machine for?

Knit by Machine is for any machine knitter — beginner, returner, or experienced — who wants clean design, quick answers, and tools that make knitting easier and more fun.

What will I find here?

Three main areas: Ask ’n Answer (ANA) for fast, straightforward answers; Skill & Technique Guides for step-by-step help; and Interactive Wizards that handle the math so you can focus on knitting.

What are Interactive Wizards?

Interactive Wizards are smart calculators, pattern planners, and practice tools that take care of the numbers and technical details. You can spend more time knitting and less time crunching math.

How often is new content added?

New ANA entries, guides, and tools are added every week. Your feedback helps shape what comes next — tell me what would make your knitting easier.
